title: Yellowed Buttery Polish Bread Flatbread
description: A traditional Polish flatbread featuring strong white bread flour, butter, and a crumbly texture, cooked to perfection on a cedar plank. This shojin-friendly dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, proof the yeast by adding it to the warm water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the melted butter and yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough on a cedar plank and shape it into a flatbread.
Let the flatbread simmer over low heat for 15 minutes on each side, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the flatbread into wedges and serve warm.
